title: Clinton and Obama both deny anything underground at Area 51

tellings.quote: What a weird thing to say about it. They both said, yeah, there's nothing underground at Area 51.

plain: Presidents Bill Clinton and Barack Obama both said there is nothing underground at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada. The researcher Jason Simosa tells this to Michels and finds it odd: "What a weird thing to say about it." He names no source, and he raises it because he reads the denial itself as a hint that something is hidden below ground there.
